claimBoundary: This does not prove long-form research guidance is never useful to human/Agent readers.
It does show that the global method failed its preregistered incremental decision-value survival rule on a valid frozen classification workload.
No V2 prompt/evaluator tuning is authorized solely to retain the method.

interpretation.cost: Global context used 2.128x the Provider tokens.
interpretation.development: Global method improved 23/24 versus local 22/24, a one-decision gain.
interpretation.errorPattern: Global method did not repair the recurrent missing-rollback confusion, increased owner-local-gap no-action errors, and introduced one holdout-tie invalidation error.
interpretation.holdout: Global method regressed to 6/12 versus local 8/12.
interpretation.meaning: The reusable experiment discipline is real, but the 294-line/9.8KB global active method artifact did not add stable incremental decision value beyond a concise task-local frozen manifest on this bounded workload.

nextWave: COMPOSED contraction shadow: remove/archive the strongest deletion candidates together, extract only current utilities, and run production/shared/current-authority plus adversarial mixed invariants.

preliminaryDisposition.CR-17: retain bounded adaptation discipline, not the full global Method/CEL apparatus. P2 rollback/held-out self-reform remains evidence; the representation carrying the discipline should be smaller.
preliminaryDisposition.CTRL-04: narrow/localize — keep a compact reusable research contract/checklist or generator; each experiment should freeze its own exact mission, oracle, authority, stop/deletion and rollback conditions. Do not treat research-method-v1 as a semantic authority merely because checkers reference it.
